title: Currentrefinements widget should be able to sort numerical values as a number and not alphanumerically when multiple values for one facet are chosen and the facet value is a number.
explanation: The issue describes a clear and specific improvement to the 'currentrefinements' widget, showing a well-thought-out use case and providing steps to reproduce the issue. The user expresses joy at the potential improvement and gratitude for the consideration of this feature.
